EXPLORE COGNOS

The modules that run every workload.

Foundational modules every workload runs on, plus specialized modules for trading, geospatial, and software intelligence work.

Foundational modules

Every workload runs on these. They provide security, orchestration, and the shared services the platform depends on.

Core

Security, governance, audit trail, and cost controls that every workload runs on. Keeps AI activity safe, accountable, and within budget.

Orchestration

The engine room where AI agents and workflows actually run. Runs the agents and automations that get work done.

Knowledge Mesh

A searchable model of the organization's knowledge that agents can query. Grounds agent answers in real company data, with full traceability.

Event Fabric

The real-time backbone that moves events and data the instant they happen. Lets the system react instantly instead of waiting for someone to check manually.

Dataflow

Processes data and media, audio, video, images, through pipelines at scale. Handles high-volume processing reliably, from a single item to a constant stream.

Control

Admin tools for managing and operating the platform itself. Gives platform operators one place to configure and run the system.

Metering

Tracks usage and consumption across every agent and workflow. Powers accurate cost visibility and billing.

Specialized modules

Built for particular kinds of work. A workload only pulls in the specialized modules it actually needs.

Trading

Connects to brokers and markets, with built-in trading tools. Powers AI-run trading operations with broker connectivity out of the box.

Geospatial

Location intelligence: maps, geofencing, proximity search. Adds "where" awareness to workloads tracking physical assets.

Software Intelligence

Tools for designing and developing software. Powers AI-driven software development work.
